theorems.name: Submission.chartTD_weighted_blowup_integral_split
theorems.statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (M Γ : Set (Rn N)) (θ : Rn N → ℝ) (x : Rn N) (f : C_c(Rn N, ℝ)) (r : ℝ), 0 < r → NullMeasurableSet M μHE[n] → NullMeasurableSet Γ μHE[n] → μHE[n] Γ < ∞ → IsPositiveLocallyIntegrableWeight n M θ → ∫ z in M, f (blowUpMap x r z) * θ z ∂μHE[n] = ∫ z in M \ Γ, f (blowUpMap x r z) * θ z ∂μHE[n] + θ x * (∫ z in Γ, f (blowUpMap x r z) ∂μHE[n] - ∫ z in Γ \ M, f (blowUpMap x r z) ∂μHE[n]) + ∫ z in M ∩ Γ, f (blowUpMap x r z) * (θ z - θ x) ∂μHE[n]
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
